title: State-space models through the lens of ensemble control
summary: State-space models (SSMs) are effective architectures for sequential modeling, but a rigorous theoretical understanding of their training dynamics is still lacking. We formulate continuous-time SSM parameter-path optimization as an ensemble optimal control problem: each input sequence generates a corresponding state trajectory in the ensemble, while the trainable parameter path forms a common control shared by all trajectories.
